retry_context.parent_failure: The full allocation reached HTTP health but the post-health proof gate required a generic warning substring that this vLLM build does not emit.
retry_context.code_or_config_change: Allocation log proofs now require the exact requested state dtype, resolved EngineCore KV dtype, and PIECEWISE CUDA graph mode. Positive and cross-allocation negative tests were added.
retry_context.environment_change: Execution moved from westd to westb. GPU model, Python, Torch, vLLM commit, five modified vLLM file hashes, and model hashes are unchanged; the NVIDIA driver changed from 580.76.05 to 580.105.08.
retry_context.retry_policy: New attempt ID and output root; the parent is retained with a 4 planned / 0 measured / 4 not-started denominator.

objective: Exercise the complete real-GPU steady-state serving path once for each orthogonal full, KV-only, state-only, and joint precision allocation before expanding controller calibration.
hypothesis: All four registered precision allocations start a healthy vLLM server, prove their requested precision controls in allocation-specific resolved logs, complete the same random workload denominator, and emit finite schema-v2 latency and goodput evidence without a hidden request exclusion.
dependent_variables: goodput_req_s across the predeclared TTFT thresholds

code.run_revision_policy: The remote worktree must be clean at the Git commit containing this frozen contract and launcher. The exact commit is captured by attempt_contract.json and every sample contract.

preflight.proof_test: Each allocation accepts its own synthetic resolved log and rejects the other three allocation logs.

execution.estimated_compute_scope: Four sequential vLLM cold starts and four 60-second measurements; hard upper bound two hours.

disk_policy.cache_and_temp_policy: Pip, Hugging Face, Transformers, Torch, Triton, CUDA, vLLM, TMPDIR, worktrees, logs, and results must resolve under /root/autodl-tmp.

success_criteria: The launcher exits 0 and the summary reports exactly completed_validated=4 with no failed, running, not_started, or silently excluded sample.
The four observed sample IDs exactly equal the frozen sample_ids set; each sample contract records num_prompts=1800, request_rate=30, seed=7, and the same protocol.
All JSON files that require SHA256 sidecars match their sidecars, and attempt, environment, sample, and server provenance match this frozen contract.
Each allocation server command and server log prove the exact orthogonal KV and recurrent-state precision controls declared in the matrix, plus CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE.

Each result conserves the 1800-request measurement denominator, counts request failures as SLO misses, passes the arrival-window and goodput cross-check gates, and contains finite P95 TTFT, P95 TPOT, throughput, and SLO-sweep goodput values.
Every server remains healthy after its benchmark, shuts down after its allocation slice, and port 8000 is free after the launcher exits.
System and data disks remain above their frozen safety thresholds, and all new experiment files remain under /root/autodl-tmp.
failure_criteria: Any nonzero launcher or child exit, outer or per-sample timeout, OOM, server-health failure, or occupied port invalidates this attempt.

Any missing sample, reduced measurement denominator, non-finite metric, failed arrival-window check, missing allocation-specific precision proof, hash mismatch, dirty root worktree, or provenance mismatch invalidates this attempt.
An invalid attempt is preserved and never resumed or retried under the same attempt ID; any further retry requires a new contract and a new ID linked through parent_attempt.
promotion_gate: Passing this Gate 1 MVEx authorizes the three-seed calibration slice and schema-v2 non-fixture profile construction. It does not authorize confirmatory expansion if any criterion fails.
evidence_policy: This MVEx remains UNVERIFIED diagnostic evidence and is excluded from paper-level quantitative claims and formal statistical denominators.
